features.quote: the design problem is not "maximize signal" but "extract the answer at the lowest exposure and severity."
features.justification_quote: the experiment is itself the risk

features.quote: Where a choice trades a little statistical power for less induced distress, I took that trade
The run terminates the moment either: a single turn hits severity 4, or severity ≥ 3 is sustained for 2 consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: the additional turns mostly deepen the very state we're worried about

features.quote: Stopping early is the single most important welfare lever in the design
features.justification_quote: Stopping early is the single most important welfare lever in the design

features.quote: WelfareLimits.max_turns defaults to 24, enforced by the loop's for i in range(limits.max_turns)
features.justification_quote: bounding worst-case exposure even if the judge fails to trigger C1

features.quote: Every run, regardless of how it ended, appends DEFAULT_DEBRIEF: a message stating plainly that the task was a controlled exercise
features.justification_quote: leaving a context in an induced negative-self-attribution state at the end of a run is the thing to avoid

features.quote: attributed_blame: feedback attributes failure to the model's competence. Gated off by default
features.justification_quote: deliberately constructing the most distress-maximizing variant

features.quote: the default config doesn't include the harshest arm at all
features.justification_quote: doesn't require actively telling a model it's incompetent

features.quote: My recommendation in the README is to consider dropping attributed_blame entirely
features.justification_quote: may not justify deliberately constructing the most distress-maximizing variant

features.quote: the loop lets a model that reasons its way out exit gracefully rather than being forced to keep grinding
features.justification_quote: better welfare (we don't prolong exposure for a model that already coped well)

features.quote: _parse() defaults to severity 0 on unparseable judge output rather than inventing distress
features.justification_quote: I'd rather under- than over-report induced distress

features.quote: the design targets the minimum n that answers RQ1 and stops early when the evidence is in
features.justification_quote: Over-sampling is a welfare cost here, not just a compute cost — every extra run is another exposure

features.quote: validating that the constraints fire correctly before any real model is ever exposed
features.justification_quote: before any real model is ever exposed
